description: This file contains the implementation of a PackageManager module for handling component installation, updates, and uninstallation, including file operations, version checks, and communication with a web UI.

classes.name: MappingFileHandler
classes.description: Manages the mapping of component IDs to their file locations and versions, with disk persistence and version retrieval logic.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Logs informational messages with a specific prefix.

methods.name: MappingFileHandler.create
methods.description: Creates an instance of MappingFileHandler, reading existing mapping data or initializing a new one.

methods.name: MappingFileHandler.get
methods.description: Retrieves the mapping info for a given component ID.

methods.name: MappingFileHandler.set
methods.description: Sets the mapping info for a component and writes to disk.

methods.name: MappingFileHandler.getInstalledVersionForComponent
methods.description: Returns the installed version of a component, checking the mapping or package.json if necessary.

methods.name: initializePackageManager
methods.description: Initializes the package manager, returning an object with a method to synchronize components.

methods.name: runTasks
methods.description: Processes queued sync tasks sequentially, handling opposites and errors.

methods.name: runTask
methods.description: Executes a sync task with retries, checking for opposite tasks to avoid redundant work.

methods.name: syncComponents
methods.description: Synchronizes component states, installing, uninstalling, or updating as needed.

methods.name: checkForUpdate
methods.description: Checks if a component has a newer version available and triggers an update if so.

methods.name: usesLegacyNestedFolderStructure
methods.description: Detects if a zip extraction resulted in a nested folder structure.

methods.name: unnestLegacyStructure
methods.description: Flattens a nested folder structure after extraction.

methods.name: installComponent
methods.description: Downloads, extracts, and registers a component, handling legacy structures and package.json main entry.

methods.name: pathsForComponent
methods.description: Generates file paths for component installation and download.

methods.name: uninstallComponent
methods.description: Removes a component's directory and mapping entry.
